Use Group for a set of attachments. Each Root can contain Media, Content with Title and Description, and Actions.

## Usage

```ts
import { attachment, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/attachment';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/attachment`. It [registers](../../registration/) 9 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.

Namespace type exports `components.AttachmentOrientation`, `components.AttachmentSize`, `components.AttachmentState`.

- `components.attachmentVariants` takes options `size`, `orientation` and optional additional classes, and returns a CSS class string.
